title: Loeb's artificial light-sail theory of 'Oumuamua
summary: Avi Loeb tells of Loeb's artificial light-sail theory of 'Oumuamua, about 2017-2021 at interstellar space, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: All of the proposals that were put on the table to explain the anomalies of Oumuamua invoked a rock of a type that we've never seen before.

plain: A Harvard scientist, Avi Loeb, talks about 'Oumuamua, an odd object that passed through our solar system in 2017 after coming from between the stars. He says every natural explanation offered for its strange behavior needed a kind of rock nobody has ever seen, and in his book Extraterrestrial he argues it may instead be an artificial light sail, a thin sheet pushed along by sunlight. If he is right, it would be a piece of technology built by someone else.
